review.method: AI-assisted observations and proposed labels reviewed and accepted by Lily in the conversation.

priority_note: Weights are prioritization weights, not answer-quality ratings. First improvement target is F1, which breaks its priority tie with F2.
overall_pass_rule: Overall pass requires all four category judgments to be pass.
counting_rule: Report category failure counts separately. Do not sum category frequencies into an overall failure count. Also report the number of distinct traces with at least one category fail.

categories.title: Classification relies on an unstated premise or extends to an underspecified product.
Explanation broadens or invents a statutory condition or consequence.
Timing summary omits the specific sections whose application is deferred.
Searches continue after relevant child passages and complete context are available.
